examples: Switch the status lights off, then the terminal ring, one at a time, while watching Activity Monitor, to find which kind of motion costs your browser the most.
Keep the spiral and cursor blink but stop the theme background effect.
how_to: Open settings, pick appearance, then the motion tab. While the animations switch is on, a list of fifteen switches appears under it, one per kind of motion.
Uncheck a kind to stop it at once, no reload; check it again to resume. Everything is checked by default.
The choice is kept in this browser only (local storage), so a test in one window never changes your phone or other windows.

Kinds: status lights, avatar spiral, selected terminal ring, dialog glow, effort badges, drawer bands, sparks and steam, busy pulses, attention cues, swarm characters, pop-ins, transitions, layout moves, theme background effect, terminal cursor blink.
name: Animation type switches
summary: under the animations switch, one switch per kind of motion, kept in this browser only, to find which animation costs the most.
